subject: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting

Team —

As we head into the 2027 budget cycle I want to lock the scope and rough budget for our annual external testing (annual pen test + light red team / adversary emulation). Procurement wants a target not-to-exceed figure and a recommended vendor so we can draft the PO.

Current ask / constraints:
- Full external web app test (prod-like endpoints) + authenticated API tests (we'll provide short-lived test accounts).
- One day tabletop + 2-day red team simulation (optional; can be add-on).
- Evidence required: SOW, SOC2 Type II excerpt / third-party insurance, and sample report template.
- Desired window: mid-February 2027 (we need results before product roadmap freeze).

Dev — can you share the shortlist and cost estimates you discussed with vendor ops last month? Evelyn — please confirm any compliance gating (log retention/forensics requirements) that would change scope. Markus — would procurement prefer a single PO for both services or split line items?

If we can get a concise recommendation by Monday I'll route to finance.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

---
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting

Hannah —

Shortlist and quick notes below (we've spoken to all three; two are reasonable fits):

1) BlueFlag Security (external vendor) — recommended
- Quote: base external web + API pen test $28k; authenticated API modules +3k; tabletop 1 day $4k; 2-day red team add-on $22k.
- Deliverables: executive summary, technical findings, remediation verification window (30 days), sample report provided.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2 excerpt available; carries E&O insurance; references from other infra teams.
- Attach: BlueFlag_RedTeam_SOW_v3.pdf (their current SOW draft).

2) PentestPros LLC — competitive alternative
- Quote: full suite $32k (includes light red team by default).
- Seems more expensive but includes a longer remediation support window. Attached PentestPros_AnnualPenProposal.xlsx.

Operational notes: schedule-wise BlueFlag can do Feb 14–18; PentestPros earliest slot is Feb 21–25. Both will require short-lived service accounts and a week lead time to provision test data.

My recommendation: go with BlueFlag for cost/timing and ask them to include a 2-business-day on-site/remote validation window as a firm price add-on rather than a vague estimate.

—Dev
Dev Patel
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: BlueFlag_RedTeam_SOW_v3.pdf; PentestPros_AnnualPenProposal.xlsx

---
From: BlueFlag Sales <sales@blueflagsec.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting

Hi Hannah / Dev —

Thanks for the details and for considering BlueFlag. Quick answers to your bullets:
- We can confirm Feb 14–18 availability for external + authenticated testing. Red team 2-day simulation add-on is available Feb 21–22.
- SOW + sample report attached. We can provide SOC2 Type II cover page and proof of insurance on signature.
- Pricing in the attached SOW: $27,500 base + $3,000 authenticated module + $22,000 red team = $52,500 if you take full stack. We can do a fixed-price red team add-on at $21,500 if committed by Dec 10.

Clarifying Qs to make the SOW final:
1) Do you want the red team focused on lateral movement and host-level persistence or purely external app-level exploitation?
2) For authenticated API tests: can you provide API keys with token TTL >= 2 hours for test sessions?
3) Any blackbox vs. greybox preference? We recommend greybox for faster coverage.

We attached BlueFlag_RedTeam_SOW_v3.pdf (includes sample report) and an initial invoice stub.

Best,
Maya Lopez
Accounts, BlueFlag Security
Maya.Lo@blueflagsec.com
+1 206-555-4444

Attachments: BlueFlag_RedTeam_SOW_v3.pdf

---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: BlueFlag Sales <sales@blueflagsec.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting

Hi Maya —

Thanks — quick compliance notes from my side that will be part of the SOW:
- Evidence: we need a signed SOW + vendor SOC2 cover page and a confirmed timeline for delivery of final report and raw findings. SOC2 excerpt must show coverage for change management and logging controls.
- Forensics: request that BlueFlag preserves all scan logs and attacker replay artifacts for 90 days (we'll need them for any follow-up audit).
- Data handling: testers must not exfiltrate PII; any sample screenshots containing customer data must be redacted in the final report.

On scope: we prefer greybox for API/auth tests. For the red team, prioritize external app -> attack path to customer data stores, then privilege escalation. 

Please update SOW with these items and confirm insurance limits. If you can provide an updated SOW by end of week we can get procurement moving.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Trust & Compliance
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

---
From: BlueFlag Sales <sales@blueflagsec.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting

Evelyn —

Appreciate the clarifications. We've updated the SOW to include: 90-day artifact retention, SOC2 cover page requirement, explicit no-exfiltration clause for PII, and insurance certificate attached on signature. Also converted red team add-on to fixed-price $21,500 if you sign by Dec 10. Updated SOW and invoice attached.

To answer Dev's earlier comment: we will run greybox authenticated API tests (token TTL >= 2 hours is great) and will focus red team on attack path to customer data stores and lateral movement.

Next steps from our side: we can issue a DocuSign envelope and a final invoice once you confirm vendor and PO terms.

Best,
Maya Lopez
BlueFlag Security

Attachments: BlueFlag_RedTeam_SOW_v4.pdf; BlueFlag_Insurance_Certificate.pdf; invoice_5251.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual security testing: scope validation + budgeting

Thanks everyone — good work pulling this together. Procurement POV:
- Approve single PO approach with line items for (1) external/app pen test, (2) authenticated API module, (3) optional red team add-on (so finance can code as capex/opex as needed).
- Please confirm final fixed-price for the red team add-on; Dev/Evelyn, if BlueFlag confirms $21,500 and you give the green light I will generate the PO.
- I need the signed SOW + invoice (or DocuSign envelope) to create the procurement record.

Hannah — if you approve the recommendation I will route to Finance to secure the spend against the security budget.

Markus Klein
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
